title: Anchor-and-Harvest Curriculum: A Fully Unmasked Non-LLM Curriculum for Craftax
abstract: arXiv:2610.15328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Anchor-and-Harvest Curriculum (AHC), a domain-informed, rule-based training system for Craftax-Full. AHC combines achievement-oriented tasks, harvested initial-state progress, difficulty adaptation, bounded selection, and original-task practice. It uses no LLM inference and keeps all 43 actions available. At 2,005,401,600 PPO rollout transitions, three primary AHC runs obtain native-task return $46.70\pm0.57$ (sample SD), compared with $41.91\pm1.01$ for fresh native PPO-GTrXL with the same student architecture and evaluation protocol. Evaluation uses ten stochastic rollouts on each of 1024 fixed worlds per model. An additional cohort of three AHC runs reaches $46.08\pm1.23$. Two single-component ablations retain similar mean returns, while jointly freezing difficulty and removing inherited progress gives $45.14\pm2.79$. All-67-achievement profiles show that most of the return difference comes from Intermediate achievement

translated_title: 锚定与收获课程：一种面向Craftax的完全无掩码非大语言模型课程
translated_abstract: 我们提出了锚定与收获课程（AHC），这是一个面向Craftax-Full的、由领域知识驱动的基于规则的训练系统。AHC结合了面向成就的任务、收获的初始状态进度、难度自适应、有界选择以及原始任务练习。它不使用任何大语言模型（LLM）推理，并保持所有43个动作始终可用。在2,005,401,600个PPO采样转移后，三次主要AHC运行获得了46.70±0.57（样本标准差）的原始任务回报，而采用相同学生架构和评估协议的全新原生PPO-GTrXL的回报为41.91±1.01。评估方式为每个模型在1024个固定世界中的每一个上进行十次随机采样。另一组三次AHC运行达到了46.08±1.23。两个单组件消融实验仍保持了相近的平均回报，而同时冻结难度并移除继承进度则得到45.14±2.79。全部67项成就的画像分析显示，回报差异的大部分来自中级（Intermediate）成就。
tldr: 提出了一种无需LLM推理、基于规则且动作完全无掩码的课程训练系统AHC，通过成就导向任务、收获初始进度与难度自适应等机制，在Craftax-Full上将PPO-GTrXL的原始任务回报从41.91提升至46.70。
en_tdlr: Proposes Anchor-and-Harvest Curriculum (AHC), a rule-based, fully unmasked non-LLM curriculum combining achievement-oriented tasks, harvested initial-state progress, and difficulty adaptation, which boosts the native-task return of PPO-GTrXL on Craftax-Full from 41.91 to 46.70.
